environment: Node with jsdom 26.0.0, fake-indexeddb 6.0.0 and Web Crypto; no browser/device or server execution
checks: Rejected storage commit retains unsaved event fields and permits retry without claiming success
Retry persists the edited event once with the original server revision
Duplicate-edit rejection preserves the existing operation and keeps the new input available
Lock clears unsaved fields from the screen and retains the encrypted outbox
Late failure after a profile change cannot replace the new profile screen or show the old error
